title: Modeling Multi-level Context for Informational Bias Detection by Contrastive Learning and Sentential Graph Network

bias_targets.methodology: Sentence-level binary classification (biased vs. non-biased) on the BASIL dataset using MultiCTX, a model that combines supervised contrastive learning for sentence embeddings (CSE) with a Self-supervised Graph Attention Network (SSGAT) to encode multi-level textual context (neighborhood, article, and event levels).
